strict_interpretation.observations: history sensor/odometry/goal. Never feed human/world GT from LABEL into robot online observation.
strict_interpretation.action_condition: recorded FUTURE executed robot commands, not counterfactual interventions, not optimal actions.
strict_interpretation.future_bev: observed from future depth, not fully known world occupancy or model output.
strict_interpretation.missing_labels: M1 tracked associations, H1-H5 persona and RL reward are not validated in first batch.
strict_interpretation.unknown_cells: -1 means unknown, not empty; mask them in loss.
strict_interpretation.test: do not explore labels or tune models against test family before final protocol.
strict_interpretation.statistical_unit: 8 episodes are independent trial units; overlapping windows are strongly correlated.
